title: Saved ContextPack metadata directory v1
description: Complete success page from GET /v1/context-packs, SDK/CLI directory reads and JSON inside MCP list_context_packs text. Records contain saved metadata only, including expired or stale packs.
$comment: Source artifact only; no validator, generator or runtime verification was executed. Register this whole self-contained local resource before resolving anchors. The ID is an identifier, not a hosted endpoint. Retain parseContextPackDirectoryQuery/Record/Envelope, canonical cursor parsing, original request bindings and trusted Gateway visibility checks. This is not a full pack read, HTTP header/status schema, MCP outer wrapper, Mock seed/session or SDK options schema.

ulid.$comment: Matches existing isUlid length/characters; no new first-character restriction.

requestTrace.$comment: Runtime isSyncIdentifier rejects unpaired surrogates and counts UTF-16 units, whereas JSON Schema length counts code points. Trace must equal the original request. DEL is not excluded by this shared trace rule.

clientConstraint.$comment: CLI identity parsing rejects C0, DEL and unpaired surrogates; SDK capture additionally limits client to 255 UTF-16 units. Runtime checks equality with the actual client. This field is a constraint, not a credential.

timestamp.$comment: Runtime requires exact valid UTC millisecond round-trip and created_at < expires_at. Format may be annotation-only. Already expired records remain eligible for the metadata directory.

ContextPackDirectoryCursor.$comment: Lexical boundary only. Runtime decodes canonical unpadded base64url JSON [1, lowercase 64-hex binding, positive safe version, ULID] and requires exact re-encoding. Binding covers the original identity/visibility/query scene; Mock bindings are isolated from production. A cursor is neither a credential/signature nor a cross-page snapshot.

ContextPackDirectoryQuery.$comment: SDK/MCP JSON input, limited to 4096 bytes at runtime. Omitted limit normalizes to 25; default is an annotation, not mutation. Public HTTP uses URL parameters, not a GET body. Optional JavaScript undefined removal is an SDK adapter behavior, not a JSON Schema value. No identities, timeout, signal or write fields.

ContextPackDirectoryNormalizedQuery.$comment: The response echoes explicit limit and the original optional filter/cursor; runtime compares the normalized query to the original captured request.

ContextPackDirectoryCliQuery.$comment: context list-packs JSON/file/network-stdin input is limited to 4096 bytes; omitted input becomes {}. Both identity constraints may be omitted or must appear together. Trusted identity stays external. --timeout-ms is a CLI option, not a JSON property. Do not send this extended object as SDK/MCP query or GET body.

ContextPackDirectoryRecord.$comment: Exactly six saved scalar fields, at most 2048 bytes at runtime. Runtime additionally requires used_tokens <= budget_tokens and created_at < expires_at. No content, hash, revision, ETag, classification or per-pack source references. Metadata does not prove current readability, token-estimation accuracy or source freshness.

ContextPackDirectoryScope.$comment: Must match all three fields of the original captured project scope. Structural validity does not authorize access.

ContextPackDirectorySourceRef.$comment: One directory marker, with id equal to scope.project_id and the original project. It is not a saved-pack source or evidence of source validity.

ContextPackDirectoryEnvelope.$comment: Complete page limited to 256 KiB at runtime, with ordinary finite JSON/depth/node budgets. Runtime verifies original trace/scope/query/source, unique pack IDs (uniqueItems only compares whole records), exact filter, version then ASCII/C ULID descending order and data.length <= query.limit. All rows must follow the original cursor. next_cursor requires a full nonempty page without exact filter, decodes to the last row, and keeps the original binding when supplied. Cross-field equality/order, canonical cursor decoding, byte/UTF-16 budgets, authentication and visibility cannot be established by this schema. Empty pages are valid; do not invent a continuation or exclude expired/stale metadata.
